title: Bank deposit
description: In isometric ink: a small bank in a pastel of your brand, five coins on the ground beside it that leap into the door one by one on an arc, and a balance card on the left whose dollar figure counts up with every credit. A hero object for banking, savings and fintech sites; leans with the pointer; in your theme.
